Name: CS_LIGHTING_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Local light settings for each level of the Lighting Quality option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 1.

Fields.Name: Local Light Distance Factor
Fields.Description: Multiplier on the draw distance of local (point and spot) lights; smaller values make lights fade out closer to the camera.

Fields.Name: Forward Pass Lighting Enabled
Fields.Description: Enables lighting in the forward rendering pass.

Fields.Name: Local Light Shadow Level Limit
Fields.Description: Highest local-light shadow level that may cast shadows; higher values let more lights cast shadows.
